propos: Six durations, two curves. Motion confirms a gesture or places a screen.
principe: No animation is needed to understand: a state marker, a message, a counter all read fine without one. Motion never carries information on its own.
durees-propos: Values read from this page. Under “reduce motion”, the first five fall to zero.
rejouables-propos: Press “Play again”: the marker travels out, then back.
courbes-propos: Same duration for both: only the curve changes. One leaves quickly and settles, the other speeds up then slows down.
boucles-propos: The loading arc and the skeleton. Under “reduce motion” they stay drawn, motionless.
ephemere: How long the transient message stays
ephemere-propos: This is a delay, not an animation: it does not fall to zero under “reduce motion”.
ephemere-message: Report sent. It will be reviewed before publication.
reduit-propos: The phone's accessibility setting, as read by this page.
reduit-actif: The setting is active on this device: every transition duration is zero, and both the arc and the skeleton are frozen.
reduit-inactif: The setting is not active on this device. If it were, every transition duration would be zero and both the arc and the skeleton would be frozen.
reduit-preuve: The proof is above: the token list shows the value actually applied, not the one written in the theme.
immobile: What never moves: the background, the header, the tab bar. No automatic scrolling, no parallax, no bounce. Lists do not animate in — they are simply there.

usage.bref: Pressing a button, toggling a filter, a state marker appearing
usage.standard: Bottom sheet, transient message, changing tab
usage.long: Opening a document, moving between screens
usage.ephemere: How long the transient message stays; the “Undo” delay after an approval

usage-courbe.sortie: What appears or enters: bottom sheet, transient message, state marker. Leaves quickly, settles gently.
usage-courbe.standard: What moves or changes size: filter toggle, progress bar, screen transition.
